    from_timezone = pytz.timezone(from_tz)
    to_timezone = pytz.timezone(to_tz)
    
    # Parse the input time string
    dt = parse(time_string)
    
    # Localize or convert the parsed datetime to the source timezone
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = from_timezone.localize(dt)
    else:
        dt = dt.astimezone(from_timezone)
        
    # Convert to the target timezone
    converted_dt = dt.astimezone(to_timezone)
    
    # Format the converted datetime
    res = converted_dt.strftime(TIME_FORMAT)

    if TIME_FORMAT.endswith("%f"):
        return res[:-3]

import pytz
from dateutil.parser import parse

# Constants
TIME_FORMAT = "%d/%m/%y %H:%M:%S.%f"

def task_func(time_string, from_tz, to_tz):
    from_timezone = pytz.timezone(from_tz)
    to_timezone = pytz.timezone(to_tz)

    dt = parse(time_string)

    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = from_timezone.localize(dt)
    else:
        dt = dt.astimezone(from_timezone)

    converted_dt = dt.astimezone(to_timezone)

    res = converted_dt.strftime(TIME_FORMAT)

    if TIME_FORMAT.endswith("%f"):
        return res[:-3]
